en: A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a tall stone lookout tower with a balcony at the top and an attached one-story building at its base, standing on a hill with a path leading up to it. Two people are visible near the entrance. The front has printed text at the top identifying the location. The reverse side has handwritten Hungarian text, a green Hungarian postage stamp, and printed publisher information along the left edge.
